dedupe_keys.name: ep 0 tool energy poverty and social vulnerability mapping for district retrofit

description: The EP-0 tool is an open-source web platform from R2M Solution, built in the Energy Poverty 0 project funded by the EU LIFE programme, to help municipalities, housing authorities and other public bodies find and address energy poverty across urban districts. Its Building Data layer shows building-level energy consumption, emissions and geometry, classifying each building by year of construction and shape factor into archetypes from the iNSPiRe project's database of pre-simulated climate-based archetypes to estimate baseline performance and retrofit scenarios. A Vulnerability Index layer combines socio-economic, building condition and energy cost indicators into a Global Vulnerability Index shown as critical, moderate or mild. A Financial Tool estimates renovation costs, amortisation, payback and incentives, and a Catalogue presents retrofit solutions by intervention category. Coverage: districts whose building data are loaded in the tool, in an EU-funded project, with country-based subsidy information. Access: the hosted web tool and the code on Zenodo, published 2025-08-31. Licence: Apache 2.0; free. Caveats: building performance comes from archetypes, not metered data, and the countries loaded in the hosted tool are not listed in the record read. Simulation uses are screening districts for retrofit priority and pairing building energy performance with social vulnerability. Related records: the City Energy Analyst record.
